subject: Mutual Pathway Kickoff — goals & timeline (Novamed)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novamed.com>, Aiden Cole <aiden.cole@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Pathway Kickoff — goals & timeline (Novamed)

Hi Samira / Aiden —

Great to reconnect after last week's demo. I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (we're calling this a "Mutual Pathway") to align on goals, success criteria, and a target close timeline so everyone has clear ownership across technical, security, and procurement lanes. Attached is a short draft MAP and a risk checklist for your team to review.

High-level proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + confirm champion and stakeholders
- Week 1: Technical deep-dive + test dataset exchange (if applicable)
- Week 2–3: Evaluation run (30 days target window)
- Week 4: Results review + exec summary
- Week 5–6: Procurement & contract finalization

Key asks from your side:
1) Confirm champion and primary technical contact
2) Accept or edit the timeline above (we can compress to 4 weeks if needed)
3) Any mandatory procurement/security gating items we should plan for now (e.g., specific SOC2 artifacts, a legal playbook, or PO requirements)

Owner notes from our side: Marissa will run onboarding and success criteria for the evaluation; Vivek will support exec-level approvals and discount discussions if we get to procurement. I'll lead the day-to-day coordination.

Proposed kickoff: Wed 3/3, 10:00–10:30 PT — 30-minute sync to confirm scope and owners. Does that time work for Novamed? If not, share two alternatives and I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: MutualPathway_DRAFT_v1.pdf (MAP draft), Novamed_RiskChecklist.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
D: 415-555-0142 | dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@novamed.com>

Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mutual Pathway Kickoff — goals & timeline (Novamed)

Thanks Dylan — this looks good and timely. I'm happy to be the champion for this project. Aiden will be the technical lead and will help with dataset/questions during the deep-dive.

A few notes from our side:
- Procurement will likely require a standard vendor form and our privacy team will want the SOC2 report; I'll loop them in if/when we need to move contracts forward.
- Suggested kickoff: Thu 3/4, 11:00–11:30 AM ET (which is 8:00–8:30 PT) — that's tight but works for us. If you'd prefer PT morning, Wed 3/3 at 10:00 PT is also okay for me.
- Success criteria we care about: inference latency within 250ms median for our 8k token workflow, and a measurable improvement in entity extraction F1 vs our baseline. We'll share the baseline metrics ahead of the technical deep-dive.

I'll also introduce our security ops contact in a follow-up when we get to the data-sharing step.

Samira Khan
